articles.summary: WEST PALM BEACH, Fla., Sept. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Sunrise Realty Trust, Inc. (Nasdaq: SUNS) (“SUNS”), a lender on the Tannenbaum Capital Group (“TCG”) Real Estate platform, today announced its dividend for the quarter ending September 30, 2026.
articles.title: Sunrise Realty Trust Announces Dividend for the Third Quarter 2026
